items.name: Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance (IRMA)
items.what_it_checks: Independent site audits against the IRMA Standard (business integrity, social and environmental responsibility); levels Transparency / 50 / 75 / 100, valid 3 years
items.what_it_does_not: Covers only mines that volunteer; no manganese, phosphate or vanadium mine in the system; 'in process' sites have no level yet

items.name: RMI Responsible Minerals Assurance Process
items.what_it_checks: Smelter/refiner due-diligence management systems against RMI standards
items.what_it_does_not: Checks process, not outcomes at mine sites; no lists for graphite, manganese, phosphate or vanadium

items.name: No assurance scheme found — manganese
items.what_it_does_not: No RMI list; no IRMA manganese mine

items.what_it_does_not: No RMI list; no IRMA phosphate mine
